page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee-8x.48xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by Intel Xeon 8469C processors operating at 2.6 GHz. The instance delivers 192 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

This instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.33 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by eight GPUs with a combined total of 768 GB of VRAM. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions, and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and massive GPU VRAM capacity, this instance represents a high-end hardware class optimized for parallel processing. The resource configuration is designed for heavy workloads such as deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science simulations that require substantial GPU acceleration and high network throughput.
